name: Tennessee State University
oos_note: Public HBCU. Out-of-state undergraduate tuition & fees $24,264 (off-campus) for 2026-2027 from official TSU Cost of Attendance page (tnstate.edu/financial_aid/costofattendance.aspx). In-state on same page = $9,568, matching known in-state figure. Tuition & fees only, excludes room/board.
